missing: The skip decision is never applied: after `run --deps` at state A and a one-file change, the build tool still executes every test; `fenvix-skip decide` only prints REUSE/RUN lines after the fact.

missing: `decide` needs a full `--deps` capture of state B, i.e. every test must already have been run at B before anything can be decided; with only A's capture every test is RUN [no-jvm-record]. There is no decide-before-run path.
evidence: `fenvix-skip decide A/deps EMPTY --root-b .` => 7x 'RUN ... [no-jvm-record: ]'; crates/fenvix-skip/src/lib.rs:36-38 ('B is described by its own capture'), docs/JVM.md:167-168 ('online decider ... not built yet') (engine@claude/release-1)
